items.informal_name: Norm Inequality for Natural Scalar Multiplication in Seminormed Groups: $\|n \cdot a\| \leq n \|a\|$
items.type: ∀ {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddGroup E] {a : E} {n : ℕ}, ‖n • a‖ ≤ ↑n * ‖a‖
items.informal_description: For any seminormed additive group $E$, any element $a \in E$, and any natural number $n$, the norm of the scalar multiple $n \cdot a$ (defined as repeated addition of $a$) satisfies the inequality $\|n \cdot a\| \leq n \|a\|$. This follows from the triangle inequality property of the seminorm.

items.informal_name: Scalar Multiplication Bounded by Norm in Schwartz Maps
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_2} {E : Type u_5} {F : Type u_6} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ F] [inst_4 : NormedField 𝕜] [inst_5 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
  [inst_6 : SMulCommClass ℝ 𝕜 F] (k n : ℕ) (c : 𝕜) (f : SchwartzMap E F),
  SchwartzMap.seminormAux k n (c • f) ≤ ‖c‖ * SchwartzMap.seminormAux k n f
items.informal_description: For any natural numbers $k, n$, scalar $c$ in a normed field $\mathbb{K}$, and Schwartz map $f : E \to F$ between real normed vector spaces, the seminorm $\|c \cdot f\|_{k,n}$ is bounded above by $\|c\| \cdot \|f\|_{k,n}$, where $\|\cdot\|_{k,n}$ quantifies the decay rate of the $n$-th derivative weighted by $\|x\|^k$.

items.informal_name: Bound on Seminorm q in Terms of p via Scalar Multiplication
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_3} {E : Type u_7} [inst : NormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : Module 𝕜 E]
  (p q : Seminorm 𝕜 E) {ε : ℝ} {C : NNReal},
  0 < ε →
    ∀ {c : 𝕜}, 1 < ‖c‖ → (∀ (x : E), ε / ‖c‖ ≤ p x → p x < ε → q x ≤ (C • p) x) → ∀ {x : E}, p x ≠ 0 → q x ≤ (C • p) x
items.informal_description: Let $ p $ and $ q $ be seminorms on a seminormed $ \mathbb{K} $-module $ E $, let $ \varepsilon > 0 $, $ C \in \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $, and $ c \in \mathbb{K} $ with $ \|c\| > 1 $. If for all $ x \in E $, the inequality $ \frac{\varepsilon}{\|c\|} \leq p(x) < \varepsilon $ implies $ q(x) \leq C \cdot p(x) $, then for any $ x \in E $ with $ p(x) \neq 0 $, it holds that $ q(x) \leq C \cdot p(x) $.

items.informal_name: Existence of Rescaling to a Shell via Integer Powers in Seminormed Modules
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_3} {E : Type u_7} [inst : NormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : Module 𝕜 E]
  (p : Seminorm 𝕜 E) {c : 𝕜},
  1 < ‖c‖ →
    ∀ {ε : ℝ},
      0 < ε →
        ∀ {x : E}, p x ≠ 0 → ∃ n, c ^ n ≠ 0 ∧ p (c ^ n • x) < ε ∧ ε / ‖c‖ ≤ p (c ^ n • x) ∧ ‖c ^ n‖⁻¹ ≤ ε⁻¹ * ‖c‖ * p x
items.informal_description: Let $ \mathfrak{K} $ be a seminormed ring, $ E $ a $ \mathfrak{K} $-module equipped with a seminorm $ p $, $ c \in \mathfrak{K} $ with $ \|c\| > 1 $, $ \varepsilon > 0 $, and $ x \in E $ satisfying $ p(x) \neq 0 $. There exists an integer $ n $ such that $ c^n \neq 0 $, $ p(c^n \cdot x) < \varepsilon $, $ \frac{\varepsilon}{\|c\|} \leq p(c^n \cdot x) $, and $ \|c^n\|^{-1} \leq \frac{1}{\varepsilon} \|c\| p(x) $. This establishes the existence of a rescaling factor $ c^n $ that places $ p(c^n \cdot x) $ within the annular region $ [\frac{\varepsilon}{\|c\|}, \varepsilon) $.

items.informal_name: Seminorm Bound on Shell Implies Global Bound
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_3} {E : Type u_7} [inst : NormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : Module 𝕜 E]
  (p q : Seminorm 𝕜 E) {ε C : ℝ},
  0 < ε → ∀ {c : 𝕜}, 1 < ‖c‖ → (∀ (x : E), ε / ‖c‖ ≤ p x → p x < ε → q x ≤ C * p x) → ∀ {x : E}, p x ≠ 0 → q x ≤ C * p x
items.informal_description: Let $ p $ and $ q $ be seminorms on a $ \mathbb{K} $-module $ E $, where $ \mathbb{K} $ is a normed field. Suppose there exist $ \varepsilon > 0 $, $ C \geq 0 $, and $ c \in \mathbb{K} $ with $ \|c\| > 1 $ such that for all $ x \in E $, if $ \varepsilon / \|c\| \leq p(x) < \varepsilon $, then $ q(x) \leq C p(x) $. Then, for every $ x \in E $ with $ p(x) \neq 0 $, it holds that $ q(x) \leq C p(x) $.

items.informal_name: Rescaling Lemma for Seminorms in a Shell
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_3} {E : Type u_7} [inst : NormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup E] [inst_2 : Module 𝕜 E]
  (p : Seminorm 𝕜 E) {c : 𝕜},
  1 < ‖c‖ →
    ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ∀ {x : E}, p x ≠ 0 → ∃ d, d ≠ 0 ∧ p (d • x) < ε ∧ ε / ‖c‖ ≤ p (d • x) ∧ ‖d‖⁻¹ ≤ ε⁻¹ * ‖c‖ * p x
items.informal_description: Let $ E $ be a seminormed $ \mathbb{K} $-module with seminorm $ p $, where $ \mathbb{K} $ is a normed field. For any $ c \in \mathbb{K} $ with $ \|c\| > 1 $, $ \varepsilon > 0 $, and $ x \in E $ with $ p(x) \neq 0 $, there exists a nonzero scalar $ d \in \mathbb{K} $ such that $ p(d \cdot x) < \varepsilon $, $ \frac{\varepsilon}{\|c\|} \leq p(d \cdot x) $, and $ \|d\|^{-1} \leq \frac{\|c\| \cdot p(x)}{\varepsilon} $. This guarantees the existence of a rescaling $ d $ that places $ d \cdot x $ within an annular region defined by $ \varepsilon $ and $ \|c\| $.
